comment: Pages captured for every PR that touches visible output. A finished historical game is used so before and after show the same data; the sidebar game list is live and may differ. Add a page here when a PR changes something these do not show. The app scrolls inside its own container, so a tall viewport (not fullPage) is what captures the whole page. `click` is an optional selector clicked after the page renders, used to close the mobile sidebar that opens by default.
